reviewed_occurrences.reviewed_meaning: The policy defines Co-Payment as a cost-sharing requirement where the policyholder or insured bears a specified percentage of the admissible claim amount. This definition does not itself establish that my: Optima Secure applies a co-payment.
reviewed_occurrences.reason: A generic definition cannot be promoted into a product-level cost-sharing obligation.

reviewed_occurrences.reviewed_meaning: No co-payment shall apply when an Insured Person from a lower premium tier avails treatment in a higher tier; the wording gives the example of a Tier 4 policyholder taking treatment in Tier 1 without any co-payment.
reviewed_occurrences.reason: The current conditional-copayment certification path models positive percentage-bearing obligations. This clause is an explicit non-application rule and must not be manufactured into a positive 0% obligation without a governed semantic decision.

pressure_assessment.preferred_next_question: Should governed copayment semantics add an insurer-independent explicit NON_APPLICABLE/NO_COPAYMENT rule representation, or should concept certification support evidence-backed absence/non-application directly?
